title: Exact small-site model for relative finite coefficient complexes
statement:
theorem exists_relative_finite_coefficient_model {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {B R : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing B] [CommRing R] [Finite B] [Finite R]
    (f : B →+* R)
    (K : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X (adicLisseConstantRing X B))) :
    let J := proEtaleModelTopology Y
    ∃ L : CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.D
        (CategoryTheory.ConstantCompletion.constant J B),
      (∀ q : ℤ, IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (pbcModules X (adicLisseConstantRing X B)) q).obj K) →
        IsZero ((coefficientModelCohomology _ q).obj L)) ∧
      (∀ q : ℤ, IsRelativelyFiniteLisseModule g B
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
              (pbcModules Y ((adicTowerInverseImage g).obj (adicLisseConstantRing X B))) q).obj
            ((adicTowerPullback g (adicLisseConstantRing X B)).obj K)) ↔
        SheafOfModules.IsLocallyConstantFiniteTypeModules J B
          ((coefficientModelCohomology _ q).obj L)) ∧
      (∀ q : ℤ, IsRelativelyFiniteLisseModule g R
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
              (pbcModules Y ((adicTowerInverseImage g).obj (adicLisseConstantRing X R))) q).obj
            ((adicTowerPullback g (adicLisseConstantRing X R)).obj
              ((pbcDerivedExtend ((constantSheaf (ProEt.topology X)
                CommRingCat.{u + 1}).map (CommRingCat.ofHom f))).obj K))) ↔
        SheafOfModules.IsLocallyConstantFiniteTypeModules J R
          ((coefficientModelCohomology _ q).obj
            ((adicFiniteExtension J f).obj L)))

proof.text: Define P as the actual derived inverse image of K and L as relativeFiniteModelDerived(g,B)(P), using the explicitly constructed coefficient transport. The exact pullback and transport homology isomorphisms show that zero cohomology of K implies zero cohomology of L.

Use the slice constant-model comparison with the same module M. Pull a final-object covering sieve back to an arbitrary object and then along AsSmall.down; conversely evaluate the small-site local-model condition at AsSmall.up of the final object and pull back along AsSmall.up. Convert finite underlying modules to finite generation, and finite generation over finite B back to finite underlying modules. This proves the ordinary relative-lissity equivalence. Transport it to cohomology via the exact-functor homology isomorphism.

Apply the derived scalar-transport natural isomorphism at K, map it through cohomology, and compose it with the exact transport homology isomorphism. Apply the ordinary relative-lissity equivalence over R and invariance of the covering-sieve predicate under module isomorphism.
